title: 12 Best Aperitivo in Turin
description: Discover Turin's best aperitivo spots for 2026! From historic cafes to trendy bars, find your perfect pre-dinner drink and bites experience in the heart of Piedmont.

places.name: Caffè Torino
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Vermouth di Torino (local vermouth) or a perfectly crafted Negroni, accompanied by their selection of traditional Piedmontese stuzzichini.

places.name: Affini
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their signature vermouth-based cocktails, or ask the bartender for a personalized recommendation. The small plates are always a delightful surprise.

places.name: La Drogheria
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their daily cocktail specials or a perfectly made Spritz, accompanied by their varied buffet selections which often include mini pizzas, frittatas, and gourmet sandwiches.

places.name: Bar Zucca
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Aperol Spritz or a local Birra Moretti, and make sure to load up on their traditional grissini (breadsticks) and focaccia from the buffet.

places.name: Lobelix Café
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any standard cocktail or a glass of wine, and then dive into their impressive buffet selection which often includes pasta salads, rice dishes, various fried snacks, and cold cuts.

places.name: Farmacia Del Cambio
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A unique, expertly mixed cocktail from their extensive menu, or a glass of fine Italian sparkling wine, paired with their chef-curated gourmet amuse-bouches.

places.name: Eataly Lingotto
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pair a Piedmontese wine or a craft beer with a selection of regional cheeses and cured meats from one of the specialized counters.

places.name: Qvintessenza
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the knowledgeable staff for a wine pairing with their daily selection of small plates, which might include sophisticated bruschetta or mini tartares.

places.name: Marais
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A Kir Royale or a classic French 75, accompanied by their refined selection of canapés and mini quiches.

places.name: Porto Urbano
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order An Aperol Spritz or a local craft beer while enjoying the river view. Their stuzzichini often include small pizzas, bruschetta, and savory tarts.

places.name: Barz8
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Trust the bartender with a classic cocktail like an Old Fashioned or a Manhattan, or ask for their daily special. The accompanying small plates are always a delightful surprise.

places.name: Slurp!
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try one of their unique house cocktails or a craft beer, paired with their inventive small plates that might include mini gourmet burgers, ceviche, or creative croquettes.
